comment: Drives the buildhost site deploy (.github/workflows/ci.yml runs scripts/assemble-pages.ts, built by ts0 to dist-scripts/, which assembles _site/ from this file and publishes it to sites.pazer.build; nothing else decides what gets published). Each {from, to} entry copies a repo file or directory (recursive) to a site output path rooted at https://sites.pazer.build/scratch_ui/branch/master/ (or the matching pr-<n> branch site). The library ships TWO files: scratch-ui.js (every component, one ES module built from src/index.ts) and scratch-ui.css (tokens + every component stylesheet, concatenated by scripts/build-css.ts). There is no per-component file: consumers load the whole library, so assemble-pages.ts instead checks that every component under src/components/ is imported by src/index.ts — that is what keeps a new component from being silently left out of the bundle. The spec site is served under /demo/ and src/index.html forwards the site root to it.
